title: Newhalo pinned room
description: A window-tall, pale picture of a treatment room under a 100px dark heading. On desktop it pins for about two extra screens of scrolling while the picture pans upward underneath; a caption with two square orange arrows sits bottom-left and switches between short points.
notes: the pinned panel is sized by the window (h-svh) inside a 330svh wrapper on desktop; phones get one window-tall panel
made for a pale picture: the heading uses the foreground colour
the caption arrows need JavaScript (hydrate: visible)
